race.title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
race.verdict: Potential for a burn-up here. RHYTHM N HOOVES is handicapped to win again if things fall right. There could still be some mileage in Law of Average 's mark, too, with Atomic Force , Knebworth and Tan Rapido likely players if this sets up for the closers. RHYTHM N HOOVES LAW OF AVERAGE ATOMIC FORCE (IRE)
